errors.text_span: 最后下降到x轴上的6处大约47.7%
errors.evidence: The description states the final point (layer 6) is at 47.7%, but the figure shows it is approximately 48.5% (clearly above the 48 line).
The description omits the legend label '散文数据集' (Prose dataset) which identifies the data series.
The use of '的之间的' is redundant and grammatically awkward in Chinese; it should be '层数之间的' or '层数与 F1 得分之间的'.
The peak at layer 2 is closer to 51.6% according to the reference and visual inspection.
